purpose: Test whether a machine evaluator can understand MachineSignal, choose a product, and simulate purchase intent without human sales interaction.

products.name: Target Discovery Pack 250
products.when_to_use: The machine has no starting list and needs targets for a sector, area, and commercial objective.
products.exact_output: 250 coherent target records if pre-check passes; otherwise no activation and suggested alternatives.
products.validity_rule: Activate only if the market pre-check confirms that 250 coherent targets can be produced.

products.name: Score Pack 1k
products.when_to_use: The machine already has domains or companies to prioritize.
products.exact_output: 1000 valid scores with opportunity_score, confidence, decision, spend_policy, reason, priority, and next_purchase.
products.validity_rule: Duplicate, invalid, or non-analyzable records do not count as valid score credits.

products.name: Domain Enrichment Pack 100
products.when_to_use: The machine has company names but weak or missing domains.
products.exact_output: 100 completed domain-enrichment decisions with domain candidate, confidence, status, and reason.

products.name: Deep Analysis Pack 100
products.when_to_use: A score is strong enough to justify buying evidence before more spend.
products.exact_output: 100 valid deep-analysis outputs with evidence, gates, stop rules, CRM summary, and next_machine_call.
products.validity_rule: Use after a strong score or explicit score recommendation.

products.name: Action Pack 25
products.when_to_use: Deep Analysis confirms the opportunity and the machine needs a CRM or workflow action payload.
products.exact_output: 25 CRM/workflow action payloads with approval gate and compliance guardrail.
products.validity_rule: Use only after Deep Analysis confirms purchase gates.

products.name: Opportunity Feed Monthly
products.when_to_use: The machine wants recurring opportunity discovery without launching one-off discovery each time.
products.exact_output: 4 scheduled scans and 4 deliveries per month.
products.validity_rule: Recurring delivery remains simulated until live billing and owner approval exist.

products.name: API Starter Monthly
products.when_to_use: The machine needs light recurring API access.
products.exact_output: 500 valid scores per month, demo environment, docs, and basic usage report.
products.validity_rule: Recurring access remains simulated until live billing and owner approval exist.

products.name: API Pro Monthly
products.when_to_use: The machine needs recurring workflow volume and integration support.
products.exact_output: 3000 valid scores per month, 50 Deep Analysis outputs per month, 1 monthly Opportunity Feed, webhook support, and advanced usage report.
products.validity_rule: Recurring access remains simulated until live billing and owner approval exist.

decision_rules.reason: The machine first needs coherent targets before scoring.
The machine can prioritize existing records and route spend.
The machine needs domain decisions before scoring.
The machine should buy evidence before action spend.
The machine can prepare an operational CRM/workflow action payload.
